edge_case_fix.details: The critical edge-case from iteration 162 is now fixed. When email field has autoFocus and values are set via pure DOM manipulation (no events), clicking submit now works correctly. The fix captures a snapshot of DOM values on onPointerDownCapture/onMouseDownCapture/onTouchStartCapture BEFORE blur can clear the values.

normal_typing_login.details: Normal typing login on iPad viewport (768x1024) works correctly with admin@bidblitz.ae / BidBlitz2026!

logged_in_ui.details: After successful login, the home page shows 'Admin BidBlitz' with wallet balance and all expected UI elements

fix_verification.fix_description: AuthPage.jsx now captures a login snapshot on onPointerDownCapture/onMouseDownCapture/onTouchStartCapture of the submit button. This snapshot is taken BEFORE the blur event fires, preserving the DOM values even if React re-renders and clears them.
key_code_changes: Lines 105-110: captureLoginSnapshot() function reads DOM values from refs
Lines 454-456: Submit button has onMouseDownCapture, onTouchStartCapture, onPointerDownCapture handlers
Lines 115-116: handleLogin uses snapshot as fallback: formData || snapshot || ref || state
fix_verification.why_it_works: The capture phase event handlers (onPointerDownCapture etc.) fire BEFORE the blur event on the email field. This allows the snapshot to capture the DOM values before React's controlled component behavior can reset them during the blur-triggered re-render.

critical_code_review_comments: The fix is well-implemented and addresses the root cause identified in iteration 162
Using capture phase event handlers is the correct approach for this edge case
The fallback chain (FormData -> snapshot -> ref -> state) provides robust value retrieval
